name: Hong Kong Shanghai Alliance Holdings Limited
summary: Hong Kong Shanghai Alliance Holdings has been in business since 1961 and is based in Wanchai. It distributes and processes construction materials for Hong Kong and the mainland through three divisions: steel, building products and property investment with fund management. The steel side supplies structural products and rebar services, the building products side handles coils such as galvanized and silicon steel, and it also trades sanitary ware and kitchen cabinets.
